summary: Frostbolt build to Ice Barrier: Frigid Power's 15% Frost damage stays up all fight, with Fingers of Frost, Shatter and Ice Lance on Frozen. Its 15 Arcane points take Arcane Concentration and Missile Barrage, and Incineration 5 adds Ice Lance crit.
rotation: Pre-pull: Ice Barrier at -4s, Frostbolt at -2.5s
Cooldowns (Demonic Rune, racial, Cold Snap) on a free GCD
Ice Barrier when Frigid Power has under 2s left (15% Frost damage for a minute, 5% more while the shield holds), not in the last 10s

Ice Lance on the last Fingers of Frost charge as a Frostbolt completes: the charge is spent a moment after the cast, so both read the boss as Frozen (Ice Lance does 4 times the damage and gets Shatter's crit)
Arcane Missiles on a Missile Barrage proc (free and twice as fast)
Ice Lance instead when a Frostbolt would not land before the end (its cast plus 1s)
Wand when nothing else can be cast
consumes: Scroll of Imbue Greater Frost (staff imbue, on top of the oil)
caveats: Ice Lance's spell power coefficient is 0.11, measured from level 60 combat logs (Season of Discovery's is 0.429). The client has 0.
Frostbolt X's base damage is ×1.04 the client's value.
Assumed: raid bosses can't be frozen. When Fingers of Frost charges apply is unknown.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Fireball stops at rank XI, Frostbolt at X and Arcane Missiles at VII. The books would add 50 DPS to Frost, 30 to Arcane, 17 to Fire and 0 to Frostfire.
Winter's Chill only helps Cone of Cold, which can't reach the boss from 30 yd, so its point is filler.
notes: Request written by mksettings -spec mage_frost unchanged (shared level 60 raid with Mana Spring Totem and Blessing of Wisdom in place of Might; Mage Armor; Engineering/Tailoring). It carries the spec's staff imbue scroll (Scroll of Imbue Greater Frost) as a mage option, as the preset does. Its rotation keeps Ice Barrier's Frigid Power up and casts Ice Lance on the last Fingers of Frost charge as a Frostbolt completes. Skyborne High Order since the 2026-11-01 race check (2% haste), was Undead. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD. Distance 30 yd since 2026-11-02 (standards 33, orchestration/caster_distance.md: Arcane Missiles, Arcane Blast, the wand), 25 before. Phase 0 gear since 2026-11-24 (the step 3 list, level60_phase0_mage_frost), was level60_phase1_synthetic (944.7 at 180s).
